conventions.aggregation: Raw matchup values are equal-game means against FBS opponents, completed before cutoff. Rank 1 is best: higher offense, lower defensive allowance. Prior ranks use the prior season FBS pool.
conventions.difference: market_spread_home minus model_spread_home; positive favors home against the observed spread, negative favors away. Not a cover probability or validated betting edge.
conventions.market: Named provider observed through CFBD; timestamp is retrieval, not sportsbook update time. Quotes are snapshots, never implied live. Odds are unavailable.
conventions.missing: Null means unavailable, with an availability/reason field. Missing values must never be read as zero.
conventions.ratings: Opponent-adjusted PPA/play and success fractions, deviations from league mean. Higher offense is better; lower defensive allowance is better. Not power-rating points.
conventions.spreads: Points, home perspective: negative favors home; positive favors away.
conventions.tempo: Reported offensive plays/drives per game; descriptive volume, not seconds per snap or a projection input.
conventions.time: ISO 8601 timestamps include offsets. Central display uses America/Chicago, including daylight saving changes.

cutoffs.meaning: Receipt upper bounds and prediction information cutoff, not claims of provider publication time.
